entities.name: Juan Álvarez de Lorenzana, 10th Viscount of Barrantes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Don Juan Álvarez de Lorenzana y Guerrero, 10th Viscount of Barrantes was a Spanish noble, politician and journalist who served as Minister of State from 1868 to 1869, in a cabinet headed by Francisco Serrano, 1st Duke of la Torre.
